svg.title: Kenya Maternal and Newborn Health Partnership | BHOC PPH Infographic
svg.desc: BHOC editorial infographic about Kenya’s maternal and newborn health partnership, showing a mother, newborn and healthcare worker alongside key figures on maternal and newborn deaths in Africa, the 80 million dollar five-year partnership, 21 priority counties, about 200 facilities, nearly 6 million women and newborns reached, and approximately 50 thousand deaths averted.
